description: border-collapse: collapse without text: the cells touch and share their borders, which are drawn once on the line between them; the wider of two borders wins and the table's wins the outer edge, a hidden border wins over every other and none loses to every other, a cell across columns and rows, borders on rows and on columns, borders of different styles and colors, the spacing and the padding of the table ignored, and a fixed layout.

florui.css: .wrap { position: relative; width: 340px; height: 520px; background-color: #ffffff; } table { border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0 0 8px 10px; background-color: #e4e4e4; } td { padding: 1px; background-color: #c8d8f0; border: 2px solid #202020; } .d { width: 20px; height: 10px; background-color: #d05040; } .b3 td { border-width: 3px; } .tb { border: 6px solid #4070d0; } .a4 { border: 4px solid #202020; } .b2 { border: 2px solid #d05040; } .hid { border: 4px hidden #40a060; } .non { border: 4px none; } .w5 { border: 5px solid #e0b030; } .rowb tr { border-bottom: 6px solid #8050c0; } .colb col { border: 4px solid #40a060; } .dash td { border: 3px dashed #202020; } .dbl td { border: 5px double #202020; } .sp { border-spacing: 10px; padding: 7px; border: 2px solid #202020; } .fx { table-layout: fixed; width: 200px; } .fx td { border: 4px solid #202020; } .nb td { border: 0; }
